source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC model option ctable: ODS Classification
target_translation: sas_compat.classification_table(X, y, pd) on the 105,000 training rows of the final model (X = intercept + the 18 selected variables, y = default_flag, pd = the final pd). (1) BIAS-ADJUSTED (one-step leave-one-out) probabilities: w = pd(1-pd); V = inverse(X' diag(w) X); q_j = x_j' V x_j; leverage h_j = w_j q_j; eta_j = logit(pd_j); pstar_j = 1/(1 + exp(-(eta_j - (y_j - pd_j) q_j / (1 - h_j)))). (2) GRID: ProbLevel from floor(min pd / 0.02)*0.02 to ceil(max pd / 0.02)*0.02 by 0.02 (0.000..0.880, 45 rows; pd min 0.00084, max 0.86250; pstar max 0.86374 gives the same grid, so pd vs pstar for the grid ends is untested). (3) at each level z a row is classified as an event when pstar >= z (> gives identical counts: no pstar on a grid point). n1 = events, n0 = nonevents: CorrectEvents = events classified event; CorrectNonevents = nonevents classified nonevent; IncorrectEvents = NONEVENTS classified event; IncorrectNonevents = EVENTS classified nonevent; Correct = 100*(CE+CN)/N; Sensitivity = 100*CE/n1; Specificity = 100*CN/n0; FalsePositive = 100*IE/(CE+IE); FalseNegative = 100*IN/(CN+IN); PPV = 100*CE/(CE+IE); NPV = 100*CN/(CN+IN); a 0 denominator gives missing -> EMPTY field (0.000 row: FalseNegative, NPV; 0.880 row: FalsePositive, PPV). Columns in that order (ProbLevel first). Printed: ProbLevel 3 decimals ('0.020'), counts integers, percentages 1 decimal ('93.5'). The listing shows only Pos/Neg Pred, the ODS dataset also has FalsePositive/FalseNegative = 100 - PPV/NPV

source_construct: PROC LOGISTIC nofit + roc 'Training Set' pred=pd_logistic; ods output ROCAssociation=work.roc_train
target_translation: sas_compat.roc_association(y=default_flag, score=pd_logistic, label='Training Set') -> ONE row, columns in this order: ROCModel (the ROC statement label), Area, StdErr, LowerArea, UpperArea, SomersD, Gamma, TauA (no 'Model' row: nofit fits nothing). With n1 events (default_flag=1, event='1'), n0 nonevents, P=n1*n0 pairs, N=n1+n0: an event/nonevent pair is concordant when pd_event > pd_nonevent, TIED when |pd_event - pd_nonevent| <= 1e-8 (same fuzz as RULEBOOK A8, an approximation of SAS's ROCEPS grouping; exact equality prints identically on every input), else discordant; Area = (C + T/2)/P (Mann-Whitney); StdErr = DeLong: V10_i = (#nonevents below event i + 0.5*#tied)/n0, V01_j = (#events above nonevent j + 0.5*#tied)/n1, StdErr = sqrt(var(V10, ddof=1)/n1 + var(V01, ddof=1)/n0); LowerArea/UpperArea = Area -/+ 1.959963985*StdErr (95% Wald); SomersD = (C-D)/P; Gamma = (C-D)/(C+D); TauA = (C-D)/(N(N-1)/2). O(N log N) via searchsorted on the sorted nonevent/event scores, never an N1 x N0 matrix. Keep full precision in memory (downstream uses Area). Printed (proc export of the ODS dataset, formatted values): ALL SEVEN numbers carry SAS's D8. format (judge/reference/listings/train.sas.log:1989-1995), emulated exactly as the modelstat-fit row for model_coefficients.csv Estimate/StdErr: decimals = max(4, decimals needed for 3 significant digits): Area/CI/SomersD/Gamma/TauA print 4 decimals because every value is >= 0.01 (TauA 0.0895), StdErr '0.00234', '0.00357', '0.0170', '0.0159', '0.0149' (all 6 observed StdErr cells); NEVER 8.4, which prints '0.0023'. Use the one D8. helper for all seven columns, not a fixed 4 decimals. Rows with missing default_flag or pd_logistic would be dropped by PROC LOGISTIC; none exist on any input (pd never missing in train/metrics, batch-1 rows 5 and 16); work.roc_train (full precision) feeds model_summary Train_AUC (train.sas:368).
